name: Anine Cummins
title: Counsellor
description: Online counselling for adults. I work with: LGBTIQ+ clients, including trans and non-binary people; people with traumatic histories, including sexual assault and abuse; people with dissociative disorders, including DID; people with ADHD and autism, and other neurodiverse brains; activists and other people struggling with burn out. Techniques include cognitive behavioural therapy, mindfulness, bibliotherapy, internal family systems, flash technique and art therapy. Sessions are $198; NDIS clients accepted.
specialties: DID, dissociative disorders, trauma, sexual assault, LGBTIQ+, trans, non-binary, ADHD, autism, burnout, internal family systems (parts), flash technique, NDIS
identity: gender non-conforming, a proud member of the LGBTIQ+ community

name: Malan van der Walt
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Malan is an AHPRA-registered psychologist with a decade in mental health, working with adults through anxiety, depression, ADHD, grief, and trauma. As a queer practitioner, he brings genuine lived understanding to work with LGBTQIA+ clients and communities. His approach is warm and relational, drawing on EMDR and ACT alongside psychodynamic approaches, and moving at the client's pace. Fridays in-person in Carlton; telehealth by arrangement; accepts Mental Health Care Plans.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, complex presentations, LGBTQIA+ affirming care, ADHD, neurodivergence, grief, anxiety, depression, ACT, DBT, psychodynamic

name: Meg Wilson
title: Founder, Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical Registrant)
description: Meg is the founder and lead psychotherapist for Unison. For over a decade, she has integrated clinical psychotherapy with creative art therapies and systemic relationship models, with a special focus on non-typical relationship structures. Experienced in polyamory & ethical non-monogamy, relationship anarchy, LGBTQIA+ & queer affirming space, kink & sex-positive practice, complex trauma & relational distress, and psychedelic integration support. Online and in Carlton; currently waitlisting new clients.
specialties: polyamory, ethical non-monogamy, relationship anarchy, LGBTQIA+, queer, kink, sex-positive, complex trauma, art psychotherapy, DBT, EFT for relationships, multi-partner relationship systems, psychedelic integration

name: Nash Mbani
title: Counsellor & Mental Health Nurse
description: Nash is a South African-born, Melbourne-based therapist who works with couples and individuals, with relationships as her main focus — communication, repair, and staying connected through conflict and change, including for people in polyamorous and non-monogamous partnerships. She draws on more than 20 years as an AHPRA-registered psychiatric nurse and a Master of Holistic Counselling, bringing that clinical grounding into somatic work and nervous system regulation. Experienced in anxiety & trauma; works with adults, couples and kink relationships. Online or in Carlton.
specialties: relationships, couples, polyamory, non-monogamy, kink relationships, somatic therapy, nervous system regulation, anxiety, trauma, burnout, CALD community
